"""
Project Title: Fourier Neural Operator for 2D Diffusion Operator Learning (ai-ml-ds-FNOHeat2025)
File Name: fourier_neural_operator_for_diffusion.py

Short Description:
Implements a 2D Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) in Keras to learn the diffusion (Gaussian blur) operator.
Trains on synthetic random fields and their Gaussian-blurred targets.
"""

import os  # type: ignore
import datetime  # type: ignore
import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore

# 1. Hyperparameters
N_SAMPLES: int = 1000      # type: int = number of training samples
IMG_SIZE: int = 64         # type: int = grid size
BATCH_SIZE: int = 8        # type: int = 8
EPOCHS: int = 50           # type: int = 50
LR: float = 1e-3           # type: float = 1e-3
MODES: int = 12            # type: int = Fourier modes
LOG_DIR: str = "./fno_logs/" + datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# 2. Synthetic dataset: random fields and Gaussian blur via conv2d
def generate_data(n: int) -> tuple:
    X: np.ndarray = np.random.randn(n, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 1).astype("float32")  # random noise fields
    # Gaussian kernel
    def gaussian_kernel(k: int = 15, sigma: float = 3.0) -> tf.Tensor:
        ax = tf.range(-k//2+1, k//2+1, dtype=tf.float32)
        xx, yy = tf.meshgrid(ax, ax)
        kernel = tf.exp(-(xx**2 + yy**2)/(2.0*sigma**2))
        kernel = kernel / tf.reduce_sum(kernel)
        return tf.reshape(kernel, (k, k, 1, 1))
    kern: tf.Tensor = gaussian_kernel()
    y_list = []
    for xi in X:
        xi_tf: tf.Tensor = tf.expand_dims(xi, 0)
        yi: tf.Tensor = tf.nn.conv2d(xi_tf, kern, strides=1, padding="SAME")
        y_list.append(yi[0].numpy())
    Y: np.ndarray = np.stack(y_list, axis=0)
    return X, Y

X_data, Y_data = generate_data(N_SAMPLES)
dataset = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices((X_data, Y_data)).shuffle(200).batch(BATCH_SIZE).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# 3. Spectral convolution layer
class SpectralConv2D(layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self, modes: int, width: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.modes: int = modes
        self.width: int = width
    def build(self, input_shape):
        self.scale = 1 / (input_shape[-1] * self.modes**2)
        self.weights_real = self.add_weight("wr", shape=(input_shape[-1], self.width, self.modes, self.modes), initializer="random_normal")
        self.weights_imag = self.add_weight("wi", shape=(input_shape[-1], self.width, self.modes, self.modes), initializer="random_normal")
    def call(self, x):
        batchsize = tf.shape(x)[0]
        x_ft = tf.signal.fft2d(tf.cast(x, tf.complex64))
        out_ft = tf.zeros((batchsize, x.shape[1], x.shape[2], self.width), dtype=tf.complex64)
        # low-frequency
        out_ft[:, :self.modes, :self.modes, :] = tf.einsum("bxyc,cioy->bxyo", 
            x_ft[:, :self.modes, :self.modes, :],
            tf.complex(self.weights_real, self.weights_imag))
        x = tf.signal.ifft2d(out_ft)
        return tf.math.real(x)

# 4. FNO model
def build_fno(modes: int, width: int) -> Model:
    inp: Input = Input(shape=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 1))
    x: tf.Tensor = layers.Conv2D(width, 1)(inp)
    for _ in range(4):
        x1: tf.Tensor = SpectralConv2D(modes, width)(x)
        x2: tf.Tensor = layers.Conv2D(width, 1)(x)
        x = layers.Add()([x1, x2])
        x = layers.Activation("gelu")(x)
    out: tf.Tensor = layers.Conv2D(1, 1)(x)
    return Model(inputs=inp, outputs=out, name="FNO2D")

model = build_fno(MODES, 32)
model.compile(optimizer=tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR), loss="mse", metrics=["mae"])
print(model.summary())

# 5. Training
model.fit(dataset, epochs=EPOCHS, verbose=2)
model.save(os.path.join(LOG_DIR, "fno_diffusion_model.h5"))

# 6. Example Use Cases and Expected Outputs
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt  # type: ignore

def example_use_case(idx: int):
    x: np.ndarray = X_data[idx:idx+1]
    y_true: np.ndarray = Y_data[idx]
    y_pred: np.ndarray = model.predict(x)[0]
    print(f"Example {idx}: MSE={(np.mean((y_true-y_pred)**2)):.4f}")
    plt.subplot(1,3,1); plt.title("Input"); plt.imshow(x[0,:,:,0], cmap="viridis")
    plt.subplot(1,3,2); plt.title("True"); plt.imshow(y_true[:,:,0], cmap="viridis")
    plt.subplot(1,3,3); plt.title("Pred"); plt.imshow(y_pred[:,:,0], cmap="viridis")
    plt.show()

example_use_case(0)
example_use_case(1)

Key Learnings & Research Areas:

  • Fourier Neural Operator: learning operators in function space via spectral convolutions.
  • SpectralConv2D: custom Fourier layer using tf.signal.fft2d.
  • Applications: approximating diffusion/PDE operators, weather/radiation modeling, subsurface flow.
  • Keywords/Hashtags: #FNO, #NeuralOperator, #SpectralCNN, #Keras, #PDELearning.

This project showcases a deeply advanced operator-learning architecture far beyond standard Keras models.
